mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate exceeding 4.5% indicates restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment rate and declines in employment growth signal deteriorating labor market conditions, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1 above 23700 billion dollars) indicates robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where GDPC1 exceeds 23700, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) reflects strong manufacturing activity, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO rises, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Low housing starts (HOUST below 1300 thousand units) indicate a weakening housing market, depressing consumer confidence and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where HOUST falls below 1300, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in housing starts and retail sales (HOUST and RSAFS falling) signal broad-based economic weakness, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL above 325) indicates persistent price pressures, prompting central bank tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where CPIAUCSL exceeds 325, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
